confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sydney price levels for July 2026. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with events and season. Beer assumes a standard 285-300 ml draft serving. Cocktail and wine were sanity-checked against the beer anchor. The FX observation comes from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as reported in search results; the F11 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Australian and New Zealand capital cities such as Melbourne and Auckland, adjusted upward for Sydney's higher accommodation and hospitality costs.
